summary: The dossier's only regional signal for this department is administrative-capacity rather than incident evidence: Regional Management Resolution R.G.R. No 000757-2024-GR-LAMB shows the regional government regulating education-administration competences via its regional education directorate - the lever through which national 'gender ideology' disputes reach schools. No trans-specific incident, ordinance or enforcement pattern was found for this department; it is otherwise assessed at the national position (±0.02).

sources.summary: Infobae Peru (20 Feb 2025): Congress's Women and Family Commission unanimously approved a bill barring trans people from public restrooms of the sex other than their birth sex (bills 6506 and 8457, by two governing-bloc legislators), with exceptions for custody situations, medical care, and accompanying elderly, under-12 or disabled people; the initiative also requires removing restroom signage ambiguous about who may enter. Trigger was a July 2023 complaint about gendered toilet labels at Lima's international airport. National law - applies in Puno as everywhere; still requires full plenary approval.

IDEHPUCP human-rights institute analysis (15 April 2025), 'Legalised discrimination': on 2 April 2025 Congress's plenary approved, waiving a second vote, the children's-sexual-rights law, fused by the Women and Family Commission with the trans bathroom-restriction bills; critiques the measure as institutionalised discrimination against trans people under national human-rights standards.

Agencia Presentes (22 July 2024): the UPCH TLGBI Rights Observatory's annual report records 54 LGBTI killings and 170 rights violations 2020-2023, trans women the most affected (30 of 54), gay men 23, one lesbian; 19 homicides in 2023 alone (12 trans women, 7 gay men). Documents the Feb 2023 abduction of trans sex worker Rubí Torres Silvano, 31, from central Lima by the Los Gallegos gang and her murder in Carabayllo with ~30 gunshot wounds, within a pattern of gang extortion of sex workers. National stats - no department-specific cut.
